query:
INSERT INTO image_partitions
                    (image_id, partition_number, fstype, size_bytes, fs_uuid, fs_label)
                VALUES
                    (?,?,?,?,?,?)
                RETURNING
                    id as "id!: i64",
                    partition_number,
                    fstype,
                    size_bytes,
                    fs_uuid,
                    fs_label
